evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Nicole: 'This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes.' (time-boxed but no explicit dependable-quote framing or clear wait for confirmation before pivoting to walkthrough offer)
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Asked: moving out of town, 'large home' size mentioned, Monday for walkthrough. Missing: explicit name confirmation, specific cities, specific move date beyond 'Monday'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Nicole: 'before I go over that, do you have any specific concern or stressors about the moving process in general?' — asked AFTER the walkthrough was already offered and scheduled, not before probing began
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Josh raised concern about not wanting stuff in truck overnight ('I would rather not my stuff being a truck overnight that seems unnecessary'). Nicole acknowledged ('Mm-hmm, I see what you mean') but did not dig deeper with 'tell me more' — instead pivoted to explaining what they'd determine in the walkthrough.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Nicole acknowledged concerns but never reflected back what she heard.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial: Home size (large), out-of-town move, distance (3 hours), previous move experience mentioned. Missing systematic probing: property type, floor/stories, number of rooms, walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations beyond overnight concern.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Correctly offered and scheduled: 'since you're big moving from a large home we usually do a virtual walkthrough' → scheduled for Monday 3:00 PM with secure link to be sent.

top_strength: Nicole correctly identified this as a large-home move and routed to a virtual walkthrough per the script, securing the Monday 3:00 PM appointment with a clear process (secure link, email confirmation) and staff follow-up plan.
coaching_note: Ask Their Agenda before offering the walkthrough, not after it's already scheduled — Josh's overnight-hotel concern came up only after the walkthrough was locked in, and Nicole didn't probe deeper into it or reflect it back to confirm understanding.
